Name: SpaceCore
Author: spacechase0
TagLine: A framework mod used by some of my other mods.
Description:
**SpaceCore** is a framework mod used by some of my other mods. It also adds a bunch of features for content pack authors.

**Install**

1.  Install the latest version of [SMAPI](https://smapi.io).

2.  Unzip the mod folder into [font=Courier New]Stardew Valley/Mods[/font].

3.  Run the game using SMAPI.
**Use**

*   **For players:** just install the mod normally, and it'll work for the mods that need it.

*   **For mod authors:** SpaceCore's functionality is documented on the [readme on github](https://github.com/spacechase0/StardewValleyMods/tree/develop/framework/SpaceCore/docs).

**Compatibility**
Compatible with Stardew Valley 1.6.15+ on Linux/macOS/Windows, both single-player and multiplayer (make sure all players have the mod installed!).

**See also**

*   [Documentation](https://github.com/spacechase0/StardewValleyMods/tree/develop/framework/SpaceCore/docs)

*   [Source code](https://github.com/spacechase0/StardewValleyMods)

Banner image by DecidedlyHuman (using vanilla assets).
